messages:
Priya: quick thread - thinking about an "entropy-aware" auto-fallback mode for rollouts. instead of only looking at error% or latency, we measure response entropy collapse as a signal to degrade. low entropy often indicates model hallucination / repetition. want opinions on UX + audit needs.
Tom: ooh that's neat. how do you compute entropy in prod cheaply? rolling digest over token probs? :brain: 
Priya: lightweight proxy: use token-diversity (unique token ratio over sliding window) + perplexity estimate from a cheap ngram model. constant-time sketch, no full softmax needed. we already expose a token-level stream, so we can sample.
Evan: from an operator POV we need a clear reason code in the audit: e.g., `reason=entropy_low_v2` and a confidence score. otherwise customer questions will be a mess.
Priya: agreed. UX idea: in rollout console show a small stacked badge next to the mode with icons: latency / error / entropy. hover -> short explainer + measured value. clicking opens a compact audit row with: timestamp, route_pct, primary_signal, delta_cost_est.
Tom: compact audit row should be one-line for most cases. expand only when you click. audit row fields we should always include (even if sampled): rollout_id, decision_type (auto/manual), reason_code, routed_from, routed_to, signal_snapshot. keep it CSV-like for easy export.
Evan: sampling: for high QPS customers sampling all decisions is impossible. propose two-tier sampling: 0.01% full-trace, 1% compact-audit (the one-line rows), and event-triggered full-trace on threshold-crossing. also make retention configurable for enterprise.
Priya: proposal for operator controls: quick freeze button (0-click stops auto-routing), a fast revert (replay last 10s routing decisions to reproduce), and a "why" helper that runs on a sampled trace and returns top-3 signals.
infra-bot: reminder: any new signal used for routing must be added to metric catalog with SLOs and cost forecasts. open ticket infra/metrics-987.
Tom: API sketch for rollout config (compact):
```json
{
  "id":"r_entropy_01",
  "mode":"entropy_aware",
  "signals":["latency_95","error_rate","token_diversity"],
  "actions":{
     "probabilistic":true,
     "hard_escalate":{
        "window":"60s",
        "threshold":0.25
     }
  },
  "sampling":{
     "compact_audit_rate":0.01,
     "full_trace_rate":0.0001,
     "anomaly_boost":10
  }
}
```
Evan: good. couple more things: 1) billing attribution for mixed routing - must appear in billing dataset with fields (orig_route, final_route, tokens). 2) show cost delta in the UI for last 24h and projected month. ops must sign off before enabling.
Priya: agreed on both. also want a human-readable audit export for legal/reg teams - one-line per decision with a short natural language explanation generated from the signals: e.g., "Auto-routed 12% to alt-model due to token_diversity=0.02 (low) + latency spike".
Tom: can that NL blurb be generated only for sampled rows? sounds expensive.
Priya: yes sample-only. keep the generator serverless and cached.
deploy-bot: will post a weekly digest of any rollouts using entropy-aware mode to #eng-platform. digest includes top reasons and a small cost delta estimate. :robot_face:
Evan: next step - Priya please draft a tiny RFC (api + ui + telemetry) and add minimal metrics budget. i'll route it to infra + security for review.
Priya: will do. tagging Tom and Evan. thanks all.
